meta.title: Kirby™ Air Riders for Nintendo Switch 2 - Nintendo Official Site for Canada
meta.description: Take to the skies with Kirby in Kirby Air Riders for Nintendo Switch 2. Race through courses, inhale rivals, and compete in aerial action.

content.value: Pick your rider, pick your machine, and mount up for competition! Take on your rivals in frantic arena battles or fast-paced races on the ground and in the air. Use the Boost Charge button to brake and control your turns as your machine automatically fights for top speed. Fill your Boost Charge Gauge as you drift around the bend and release it to trigger an explosive dash!

Ride and battle with just two buttons. Press the Boost Charge button to brake, drift, and fill your Boost Charge Gauge as your machine moves forward automatically. Once it’s full, dash forward with gusto!
Wiggle the control stick to perform a spin attack. Slam into enemies to send them flying!
Drive and fight to fill your Special Gauge. Once it’s full, you can activate your rider’s Special to edge out the competition.
Inhale or capture an enemy to receive their Copy Ability. Some Copy Abilities let you attack, while others give you bonuses like a speed increase.
A light and floaty friend to all! This well-balanced hero has no clear weaknesses.
A heavyweight rider who rules the raceway! Hits hard with his powerful hammer.
A shadowy defender who slashes rivals with his sword and slices through the air on dark wings.
A sturdy rider who builds Boost Charge quickly. His trusty spear stings rivals like a hornet!
A fierce fighter who jabs at riders that come too close. Charge up fully for a flurry of punches!
The mushroom cap doubles as a protective cushion. Race ahead of rivals before it falls apart!
Excels at airborne maneuvers. Jump for a burst of speed and soar right over your rivals!
A sly spell caster who accelerates a lot after Star Slides. Attack rivals ahead of you with perfect landings!
A smug, shiny entrepreneur. Deploys a propeller to take off and float gently through the air.
Both drives and glides perfectly well. An easy ride with no clear weaknesses.
Slow when ground-bound, but soars gracefully whenever it takes flight.
Races ahead on a single wheel. An interesting design compared to star-type machines.
Light as paper with impressive flight capabilities. Fragile, but offers excellent acceleration.
Rushes forward on Boost Dashes. Boost Charges help it tackle turns at a rapid pace.

Zip around the city of Skyah in City Trial: a free-for-all battle for 16 players online* or up to 8 players via local wireless.** You have 5 minutes to collect power-ups and prepare your machine for a Stadium contest.
Find items scattered all over Skyah to raise your machine’s stats.
Clash with rivals in a competition to claim power-ups! Watch out for opponents looking to thwart you by destroying your machine...
Survive unpredictable Field Events like fearsome boss battles, falling meteors, and more!
The final challenge takes place at the Stadium! The challenge is chosen from one of four randomly selected options. Try and pick one that suits your powered-up machine.
Drive, fight, and aim to cross the finish line first. Compete against a medley of riders in local and online matches with up to 5 other players.
For a different perspective altogether, try Top Ride, where you view your Rider from a bird’s eye vantage and the entire track is on screen from start to finish.

Complete stages of single-player challenges, featuring all the playstyles found in the game’s multiplayer modes, to progress through a wild and unusual story. Choose any rider you like, and put your skills to the test!
Gather groups of up to 32 players online* in the Paddock, a lobby where you can hang out to play matches in City Trial, Air Ride, Top Ride, and more.
Drift into a casual game online or dash and tussle for the top in all-out ranked matches.
Create a signature look for your machine using a spread of cosmetic options, including accessories, decals, patterns, special effects, and more.
Buy and sell customized machines using Miles: in-game currency you can earn by competing and completing challenges.

Mix and match in-game Figure Players with the new rider-machine dual pack amiibo™ figures! Each pack comes with one rider and machine, which together form a figure. You can change the combination of your riders and machines to make different figures, too.
Tap them into your game to play with your Figure Players! By racing together with them, their level and machine's proficiency will increase.

Product:{\"sku\":\"7100103775\"}.description({\"html\":true}):
Pick your rider, pick your machine, and mount up for competition! Take on your rivals in frantic arena battles or fast-paced races on the ground and in the air. Use the Boost Charge button to brake and control your turns as your machine automatically fights for top speed. Fill your Boost Charge Gauge as you drift around the bend and release it to trigger an explosive dash!

Choose from a variety of riders like Kirby, Meta Knight, King Dedede, and Magolor from the Kirby’s Return to Dream Land™ game, and machines including the Warp Star, Wheelie Bike, Chariot, and more. Each combo handles differently, with its own set of stats and Specials, and each rider can grab Copy Abilities off their foes to get an edge in the fray.

Compete in a variety of modes, all of which you can play casually or in competitive ranked matches—whether online*, locally on a single system, or via local wireless**.

Take on highly varied arena battles in City Trial, or race to the finish in Air Ride and Top Ride

Zip around the city of Skyah in City Trial: a free-for-all battle for 16 players online* or 8 players via local wireless** . Roam around Skyah to find machines, collect power-ups, and survive through unpredictable Field Events ranging from falling meteors to powerful boss battles. After five minutes of powering up, you and your rivals will compete in one of a whole host of different Stadium contests, each with its own objective. These include drag races, battle arenas, skydiving for points and more, so it helps to be ready for anything!

If more straightforward racing is to your liking, check out Air Ride: a frantic dash against 5 other Riders online or via local wireless. Attack opposing Riders, or trail close behind their wake, to gather up stars—and use the speed boost they provide to beat your rivals to the finish line. For a different perspective altogether, try Top Ride, where you view your Rider from a bird’s eye vantage and the entire track is on screen from start to finish.

Discover the story of Zorah in the single-player Road Trip mode

Complete stages of single-player challenges, featuring all the playstyles found in the game’s multiplayer modes, to progress through a wild and unusual story. Choose any Rider you like, and put your skills to the test to learn more!

Meet up with other players in the Paddock and trade with them at the Machine Market

Gather groups of up to 32 players online in the Paddock, a lobby where you can hang out to play matches in City Trial, Air Ride, Top Ride, and more.

You can also buy and sell machines, using an in-game currency called Miles, at the Machine Market! As you compete and complete challenges, you’ll earn Miles that you can spend to unlock cosmetic options like accessories, decals, patterns, special effects, and more. Customize the look of your machine, put it up for sale on the market, and other players will be able to spend their Miles to purchase your creations. You can also purchase and use other players’ customized machines.
